༄7//〈byang chub lam rim chen mo'i 〉sa bcad/ 695dang / brtan pa dang / dga' ba'i stobs skyed pa dang / dor ba'i stobs so/ lnga ba bsam gtan gyi phar phyin bslab pa la lnga/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo/de sgom pa la 'jug pa'i thabs/ bsam gtan gyi rab dbye/ bsgrub pa'i tshe ji ltar bya ba/ de dag gi don bsdu ba'o// drug pa shes rab kyi bslab pa la lnga/shes rab kyi ngo bo/ de skyed pa la 'jug pa'i thabs/ shes rab kyi rab tu dbye ba/ bsgrub pa'i tshe ji ltar bya ba/ de dag gi don bsdu ba'o// gsum pa/shes rab kyi rab tu dbye ba ni gsum ste/ don dam rtog pa dang / kun rdzob rtog pa/ sems can gyi don bya ba rtogs pa'i shes rab bo//gzhan gyi rgyud smin par byed pa bsdu ba bzhi la lnga/ bsdu bzhi'i ngo bo// bzhir bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bsdu bzhi'i byed las/ 'khor sdud pas de la brten dgos pa/cung zad rgyas par bshad pa'o// gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad/ khyad par du phar phyin tha ma gnyis la bslab pa la drug zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong bsgom pa'i phan yon/ de gnyis ting nge 'dzin kun gyi bsdu byed du bstan pa/zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gi ngo bo/ gnyis ka bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/go rim nges pa'i tshul/ so so'i bslab tshul lo// drug pa/ so so'i bslab tshul gsum/ zhi gnas la bslab tshul/ lhag mthong la bslab tshul/ de gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i tshul lo// dang bo la gsum/ zhi gnas kyi tshogs bsten pa/ de la brten nas zhi gnas bsgom pa'i tshul/ bsgom pas 'i gnas grub pa'i tshad do// dang bo la drug mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa/ 'dod pa chung ba/ chog shes pa/ bya ba mang bo yongs su spangs ba/ tshul khrims rnams par dag pa/ 'dod pa la sogs pa'i rnam rtog yongs su spangs pa'o//gnyis pa/ de la brten nas zhi gnas bsgom pa'i tshul la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang / dngos ga'i'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'u/sa kyi spyod lam ci 'dra bas bsgom pa dang / bsgom pa'i rim pa nyid bshad pa'o/ 'dir yang / ting

696 ༄za//〈bka' 'gyur 〉klog skabs dran gsor bris deb/ zur bkod/nge 'dzin gyi bsgrub tshul rnam bshad pa la gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin skyon med bsgyed pa'i tshul dang / de la bsten nas sems gnas skye ba'i rim pa'o//dang bo la gsum/ sems dmigs pa la gtod ba'i sngon du ji ltar bya ba dang /dmigs pa la gtod pa'i dus su ji ltar bya ba dang / dmigs pa la gtad pa'i 'og tu ji ltar bya ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ sems gang la 'jog pa'i gzhi dmigs pa nges bzung ba dang / de la sems ji ltar gtod pa'i tshul lo//dang bo la gnyis/ dmigs pa spyis rnam par ba'ag pa dang / skabs su bab pa'i dmigs pa nges bzung ba'o// dang bo la gsum/ dmigs pa dngos bstan pa dang / gang zag gang gis gang la dmigs par bya ba bstan pa dang /dmigs pa'i rnam grangs bstan pa'o// gnyis pa/ de la sems ji ltar gtod pa'i tshul la gsum/ skyon med pa'i lugs bzhag pa dang / skyon dang bcas pa'i lugs bsal ba dang / thun gyi tshad bstan pa'o// gsum pa/ dmigs pa la gtad pa'i 'og tu ji ltar bya ba la gnyis/ bying rgod byung ba'i dus su ji ltar bya ba dang / bying rgod dang bral ba'i dus su ji ltar bya ba'o// dang bo la gnyis/ bying rgod ngos mi zin pa'i gnyen po bsten pa dang / ngos zin kyang de spong ba'i phyir du mi rtsol ba'i gnyen po brten pa'o// dang bo la gnyis/bying rgod kyi mtshad nyid gtan la dbab pa dang / bsgom pa'i dus su de gtogs pa'i shes bzhin bskyed pa'i thabs so// gnyis pa/ de la brten nas sems gnas skye ba'i rim pa la gsum/ sems gnas skye ba'i rim pa nges te stobs drug gis 'grub lugs de yid la byed pa bzhi yod pa'i tshul lo//dang bo la sems dgu las/ de dang de la sems 'jog pa/ rgyun du 'jog pa/blan te 'jog pa/ nye bar 'jog pa/ dul bar byed pa/ zhi bar byed pa/rnam par zhi bar byed pa/ rtse gcig tu byed pa/ mnyam par 'jog pa'o//gnyis pa la/ stobs ni drug ste/ thos pa'i stobs/ bsam pa'i stobs/

ro༅//〈byang chub lam rim chen mo'i 〉sa bcad/ 697dran pa'i stobs/ shes ba'in gyi stobs/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs/ yongs su 'dris ba'i stobs so/ /gsum pa/ bsgom pas 'i gnas grub pa'i tshad la gsum/ 'i gnas grub pa dang ma grub pa'i sa mtshams bstan pa dang / zhi gnas la rten nas lam bgrod tshul spyir bstan pa dang / khyad par du 'jig rten pa'i lam bgrod tshul bstan pa'o// dang bo la gnyis/ dngos kyi don bstan pa dang / yid byed dang ldan pa'i rtags dogs gcod dang bcas pa'o// gsum pa khyad par du 'jig rten pa'i lam bgrod tshul bstan pa la gnyis/zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi lam bgrod pa'i sngon du zhi gnas thob dgos par bstan pa dang / zhi gnas la bsten nas 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral bar byed pa'i tshul lo//gnyis pa/ lhag mthong la bslab pa'i tshul la bzhi/ lhag mthong gi tshogs bsten pa dang / lhag mthong gi rab tu dbye ba dang / lhag mthong bsgom/ pa'i tshul/ sgom pa'i lhag mthong grub pa'i tshad do// dang bo la gsum/drang don dang ngos don gyi gsung rab nges gzung ba dang / klu sgrub gyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i tshul ji ltar byung ba dang / stong nyid kyi lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul lo// gsum pa/ stong nyid kyi lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul la gnyis/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i rim pa dang / de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa ngos so// gnyis pa la gsum/ rigs pa'i dgag bya dngos bzung ba dang / de 'gog pa de thal rang gang gis byed pa dang / byed pa de la brten nas lta ba brgyud la skyed pa'i tshul lo// dang bo la gsum/ dgag bya legs par ngos zin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / dgag bya ngos ma zin par 'gog pa'i gzhan lugs dgag pa dang / rang gi lugs kyi dgag bya ngos zin pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dgag bya ngos 'dzin ha cang khyab che ba

698 ༄7//〈bka' 'gyur 〉klog skabs dran gsor bris deb/ zur bkod/dgag pa dang / dgag bya ngos 'dzin khyab chung ba dgag pa'o/ dang bo la gnyis/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de mi 'thad par bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ lugs des dbu ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bkag par bstan pa dang / gnod byed brjod pa rnams kyis sun mi phyin par bstan pa'o//dang bo la gsum/ dbu ma ba'i khyad chos ngos bzung ba dang / lugs des de ji ltar bkag pa'i tshul dang / de la dbu ma bas lan ji ltar btab pa'o//gnyis pa gnod byed brjod pa rnams kyis sun mi phyin par bstan pa la bzhi/rigs pas dpyad bzod mi bzod brtags nas bkag pas sun 'byin mi nus pa dang / tshad mas grub ma grub brtags nas 'gog pas sun 'byin mi nus pa dang / mu ba'i'i skye ba yin min brtags nas 'gog pas sun 'byin mi nus pa dang / dngos po yod med sogs kyi mu bzhi ga 'gog pa gnod byed du mi rung bar bstan pa'o// gsum pa/ rang lugs kyi dgag bya nges bzung ba la gsum/ dngos kyi don dgag bya ngos bzung ba dang / de dgag bya gzhan la sbyor mi sbyor gyi tshul dang / dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par sbyor mi sbyor bshad pa'o// gnyis pa/ dgag bya 'gog pa de thal rang gang gis byed pa la gnyis/thal rang gi don ngos bzung ba dang / de gnyis su'i rjes su 'brangs nas lta ba rgyud la bskyed pa'o// dang bo la gnyis/ ga'an lugs dgag pa/ rang lugs bzhag pa'o// dang bo la gnyis/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o// gnyis pa la ba'i/ lugs dang bo dgag pa/ lugs gnyis pa dgag pa/ lugs gsum pa dgag pa/ lugs bzhi ba dgag pa'o// gnyis pa/ rang lugs bzhag pa la gnyis/ rang rgyud sun dbyung ba dngos dang /de rang la mi mtshungs pa'i tshul lo// dang bo la gnyis/ gzhi chos can ma grub pa'i phyogs kyi skyon bstan pa dang / skyon des gtan tshigs kyang ma grub par bstan pa 'o// dang bo la gnyis/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o//

༄7/〈byang chub lam rim chen mo'i 〉sa bcad/ 699gnyis pa la gnyis/ don mi 'thad pa dang / dpe bkod pa dang mi 'dra pa'o//gsum pa byed pa de la brten nas lta ba rgyud la bskyed pa'i tshul la gsum/ gang zag gi bdag med gtan la dbab pa dang / chos kyi bdag med gtan la dbab pa dang / lta ba de dag goms pas sgrub pa spong ba'i tshul lo// dang bo la gsum/ bdag rang gzhan med par gtan la dbab pa dngos/ des bdag gi ba yang rang ba'in med par 'grub par bstan pa/ rig pa de rnams gzhan la'ang sbyar ba'i tshul lo// dang bo la gnyis/ dpe dgod pa dang /don la sbyor pa'o// dang bo la bzhi/ shing rta rang bzhin med pa'i btags yod du bstan pa/ de la rtsod pa spang ba/ ming gi khyad par gyi sgo nas grub pa'i tshul/ de la brten nas myur du lta ba rnyed pa'i phan yon no// gnyis pa/don la sbyar ba la gnyis/ rang bzhin med pa'i tshul don la sbyor ba dang /ming gi khyad par gyi sgo nas grub tshul don la sbyar ba'o// dang bo la ba'i /bdag phung bo dang gcig pa'i phyogs dgag pa dang / bdag phung bo dang tha dad pa'i phyogs dgag pa dang / des phyogs lhag ma rnams kyang khebs par 'gyur ba dang / de la brten nas gang zag sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba'i tshul lo//gnyis pa chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bab pa/ gsum pa lta ba de dag goms pas sgrib pa spong ba'i tshul lo//rtsa ba'i sa bcad/ gnyis pa/ lhag mthong gi rab tu dbye ba ni/ de ltar skyes bu dam pa la brten pa dang / mang du thos pa yongs su btsal ba dang /tshul bzhin du sems pa ste/ lhag mthong gi tshogs gsum mo/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa/ lhag mthong bsgom pa'i tshul la gnyis/lugs gzhan dgag pa dang / rang gi lugs bzhag pa'o// dang bo la bzhi/gnyis pa la gsum/ 'jog sgom dang / dpyad sgom gnyis ka dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de la rtsod pa spong ba/ skyong tshul gyi gnad cung zad bshad pa'o//

700 ༄༅//〈bka' 'gyur 〉klog skabs dran gsor bris deb/ zur bkod/rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa/ zhi lhag de gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i tshul ni/ da ni lam spyi'i don bsdu ba cung zad brjod par bya ste/ thog mar lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul la thug pas de'i brdar sha bcad/ de nas dal ba la snying bo len 'dod bcos ma min pa bskyed na des rgyun du sgrub ba la nang nas bskul bas de bskyed pa'i phyir du dal 'byor gyi skor rnams sgom/ de nas tshe 'di don du gnyer ba'i blo rnal ma log na 'jig rten phyi ma la don gnyer drag po mi 'byung bas lus thob pa ring du mi sdod pa'i mi rtag pa dang shi nas ngan 'gror 'khyam tshul bsgom pa la 'bad/ de'i tshe 'jigs pa dran pa'i blo rnal ma skye bas skyabs gsum gyi yon tan la snying thag pa nas nges pa bskyed la skyabs 'gro thun mong ba'i sdom pa la gnas shing de'i bslab bya la bslab/ de nas dkar chos thams cad kyi gzhi chen po las 'bras la yid chos ba'i dad pa sgo du ma nas bskyed la brtan par byas te dge mi dge bcu'i 'jug ldog la 'bad cing stobs bzhi'i lam du rgyun du zhugs pa zhig bya//de ltar skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor rnams tshags su chud pa na 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi nyes dmigs mang du bsams la 'khor ba spyi las blo ci ldog bya/de nas 'khor ba gang las 'byung ba'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i ngo bo nges bzung nas de spong 'dod bcos ma min pa bskyed/ 'khor ba las grol ba'i lam bslabs pa gsum spyi la nges pa drangs shing khyad par du rang gis gang khas blangs pa'i so sor thar ba la 'bad par bya'o//de ltar skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor rnams tshags su chud pa na rang nyid srid mtshor lhung ba ji bzhin ma rnams kyang de 'dra bar song ba yid la byas te byams pa dang snying rje'i rtsa ba can byang chub kyi sems sbyangs la 'di ci skye la 'bad dgos te/de med na spyod pa phyin drug dang / rim gnyis sogs rmang med pa'i thog byed pa dang 'dra bar gyur ba yin no//

༄//(byang chub lam rim chen mo'i 〉sa bcad/ 701de la myong ba'i rnam pa than thun rgyud la skyes na cho gas bzung la/de'i bslab bya la 'bad nas smon pa ci brtan bya// de nas byang sems kyi spyod pa rlabs che ba rnams mnyan la ldog 'jug gi mtshams rnams shes pa dang / de la slob 'dod drag po bskyed/ blo de dag skyes pa na 'jug pa'i sdom pa cho gas bzung la rang rgyud smin byed phyin drug dang / ga'an rgyud smin byed bsdu ba'i sogs la bslabs/ khyad par du rtsa ltung la 'bad pa drag pos srog bsdos bya/zag pa chung 'bring dang nyes byas rnams kyis ma gos ba la 'bad cing gos na'ang phyir bcos ba la 'bad do// de nas phar phyin tha ma gnyis la khyad par du slob dgos pas bsam gtan skyong lugs la mkhas par byas la ting nge 'dzin bsgrub/bdag med pa gnyis kyi lta ba rtag chad dang bral ba'i rnam dag cig rgyud la ci skye byas te/ rnyed pa dang lta thog der bzhag nas skyong ba'i skyong tshul rnam dag shes par byas la skyang ngo // de 'dra ba'i bsam gtan dang shes rab gnyis la zhi lhag gi ming btags pa yin gyi/ phar phyin tha ma gnyis las zur ba zhig med pas byang sems kyi sdom pa bzung nas de'i bslab bya la slob pa'i gseb nas 'ong ba yin no// 'dir yang 'og ma 'og ma bsgom gyin gong ma gong ma la thob 'dod cher 'gro ba dang / gong ma gong ma mnyan pa na/ 'og ma 'og ma la bsgrub 'dod cher 'gro ba 'ig byung na gnad du song ba yin gyi/ snga ma rnams ci yang med par sems kyi gnas cha re tsam dang / lta ba'i go ba tsam re la nus pa lo tsam byas kyang / gnad du 'gro ba shin tu dka' bas/ lam gyi lus yo ngas su rdzogs pa zhig la/ nges pa 'drongs dgos pa yin no// de rnams bsgom pa'i tshe 'ang rtog pa sbyang bar byas nas blo rnams cha mnyam dgos te/ 'di ltar lam la 'khrid pa'i bshes gnyen la gus pa chung bar snang na legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'chad pas brten tshul la 'bad/ de bzhin du bsgrub pa la spro shugs chung na/ dal 'byor gyi skor dang tshe 'di la mngon zhing zhen che bar song na/

702 ༄7//〈bka' 'gyur 〉klog skabs dran gsor bris deb/ zur bkod/mi rtag pa dang / ngan 'gro'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa la gtso bor bya dgos/khas blang ba'i bcas pa rnams la g.yel bar snang na las 'bras la nges pa chung ba yin snyam du bsams la las 'bras bsgom pa la gtso bor bya/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la skyo shas chung na thar ba don gnyer gyi blo tshig tsam du 'gro bas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bsam/ ci byed sems can gyi don du byed pa'i blo shugs drag mi snang na theg chen gyi rtsa ba 'chad pas smon sems rgyu dang bcas pa la mang du sbyang / rgyal sras kyi sdom pa blangs nas spyod pa la slob pa na'ang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba shugs drag par snang na/ rigs shes kyis mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blos bzung ba'i dmigs gtad thams cad bshig la nam mkha' lta bu dang sgyu ma lta bu'i stong nyid la blo sbyang / sems dge ba'i dmigs pa la mi gtod pa'i rnam g.yeng gi bran du gyur bar snang na rtse gcig pa'i gnas cha la gtso bor skyong bar gong ma rnams gsungs te/ des mchon nas ma bshad pa rnams kyang shes par bya la/ mdor na phyogs re bar ma song bar rgyud dge ba'i phyogs thams cad la bkol du rung ba 'ig dgos so//gnyis pa khyad par du rdo rje'i theg pa la bslab pa'i tshul ni/ 'dir mang tsam gyi sgo nas sngags la 'jug pa'i phyogs tsam zhig bstan pa yin pas rgyas par ni sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa rnams las shes dgos so// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bslab na/ mdo sngags kyi gnad thams cad bsdus pa'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa la bslab par 'gyur bas dal ba thob pa don dang ldan par byed cing /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud la rgyas par byed nus pa yin no//bla brang bkra r+shasa'akhyil gyi da5na shog gungamu 510can gyi steng nasas bcad blangamu pa yin kung/ gong rgog non

༄7//(byang chub lam rim chen mo'i 〉sa bcad/ 703ba chad lhag dang skyon sogamu ngesapa ra krod srid de/ 'on kyang / rang gis bag chags cung zad tsam re 'jog tshe thub bsamayopa'i kun slong dang / skabasagang la mjal na btsayi bde bamu phyin brisapa lagasaso/nab byung 17pa'i lcags rta'i lon (1990lo)yi dzod dge lten phun ni khrod kyi nang shag spyil bu nas mtsho kha bsabrimu/

704mjug byang /)tsho/rgyul ba'i bka' rin po tshe 'di klog skabs/ yid yi mtshan snang skye/ skabs 'din phyogasatsaska zhig go ba yin nayo snyan 5 dang / dog 5 'dri bsayis 5/ yang na slan mja' me thub snyam 5/ 'din ji 'dra'i gsal bo rde gsungasayod bamuyomu pa/ skabasa'adin phyogasa'adi 'dra yod pa rnyed sla ba dang btsal bde ba'i ched sogs rang blo yinyam pa re gnyisal 5na thogasacung zad de'ang yod na snyayi nasabris khrod/ bdag la shesu nab zen ba'i dri mi munga' la/ zab cing rgya tshe ba'i phyogasadang / dka' gnad g.yi tshe ba gang yin mi shes༈bas 'bri ga 'a nus/ 'on rgyang skabs 'gan bamumamu na/ gdul bya nab 'bring tha gsumu/ dbang po rno 'bring rtu' gsum/ gang dang gang la dri ba drimu lan dang / dpe sna tshogamu sbyan te/ go sla ba'i sgo nas gsalazhing go bde ban gsungamu yod gamuthong na/ ma yichon rmi tshan ji nadra'i yijayi rgyu rde tshe/ nang blo ji nadra dayin wang / lo na nan 5'i duyosucirgaphyin ma yijayo/ lharga pan dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad ba'i dus sucis phyin yi yijal/ nang dbang krod kyang khoyo5'i dus su cisaphyir mu mjal/ ston 5 thugs rje can zhal bzhugasapa'i dus su gsung rna bas thosargyu yod pa de dag 'di 'dra yin kho thag red/ 'di 'dra'i din thang gzhayi du med pa'i gsung zab rmo ma cimu phyin snga mo namu mu yijal yim/ yi glen pa/ yolamu dang skapha ba sped pa/ oṃsbyon 5/ phyin chad lo brgya phrag stong phrag skalaba'i ban du/ chosazab tho 'di 'dra'i ming tsasma ying thomu rgyu shin tu dka' ste/ rgyu mtshan nang la dpagayon/ 'khon ban gan5pas nyin yitshan dumu drug sped sgarna/ 'dod chagasadang / zhe snang / gti snyig gsuyogyi dbang gi5than ba'i skabayomi srid 5su/ phyin chad chosazab tho 'di la yithong thos dran reg gi 'brel tsaska wang 'jog thub rgyu dka' kho thag red/ gang ltar blo dang di na pa rnaskamu kyis rgyal ba'i bka' nin po tshe thos bamuyi byed 5 dang klog 'don byed 5 ni sprung thos gser rnyed pa 'dra ste/ kho bo ni mardo sngagamu gnyisakan nang byan chud pa zhig min/ go ba rags spyi tsam yod pa zhig gi ngosanasatshan gcig dayi

༄7/mjug byang / 705banamajal na'ang / ji 'dra'i ngesagachen po rde rnyed rgyu byung song bsayosanasang pha hamu sems chen po skyesabyung /sngon pyon rgya bod kyi yikha5grub dang skyesatshen dam pa bgung mamu 'das pa5chomu tshul 'dzad pa sped pa phyogamu dang ris su yochad 5'i gsung rtsoyomu gzhi'i skyed tshalaltar snang na'ang rdon yongs surdzogasapa tshun bsdusan/ bka' din po tshe 'di na mi gsal ba gcig kung med snyam/ gal srid yod na nang snang gang dran yin pan 'dug te/ de ni nang gzhan gnyi5phung yin par 'gyun snyam lags/ ston pa thugs rje can zhal bzhugamu pa'i duyosukung / gdul bya ha cang dbang bo rtul ba dug gsusga gyisasmyoyo5'i lha mi klu dang dud 'grol sgogasang so sorna nang nang gi blo dang 'tsham pan/ byang chub kyi sems rin po tshemu kun nasabaslangs pa'i smathusagadul bya bgung 0/sa 'dasapan sadang lamu gyi rtogasapa dim dang cig chan rgyud la skyes5na smadzad pa'i tshul yitha' was pa wasaphyogs tsarma re bdag 'dra'i go ba yod na/ skakhyen dpyod wangamu pa rnamusapha zhu yidagos/ yong 'a khri/sa mam /bka' 'gyur /ha go nas zer yikhan yod rmod/ de ni kho man/jalab dang yungan kha tshong bar yi/jal sga thub pas lan pa red/ rgyayi ba'i gsung rab 'din/ tshe gcig luyogacigayo 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs tshul 'di na rmachis/ yi rdo dang ji/gas kyi thabasalam bgung 'a sa 'das thas/ mgo skyabamu 'gro namu yijug blan med pa'i byang chub thob kyi ban 'an grangs grangamu med 5ra gsungs 5'i ston pa thugasarje can gyi bka' drin ni gzha' du ma muchis pamu kung gzhal du na/ mchisagi mgasate/ bdag 'dra'i zhu ban mi spobasapo'o/ rgyal ba'i gsung dri ma sped pa bdag gis bklags ji 'i dusan brgya cha'i dgu cu wan chad kyi dgongs don 5la tsherna ha mi go lhag pan sngagamu phyogs ha gtan nas mi go bar mu zad tha na yi ge klog mishes pa'ang ying bo rmo da/ yin na'ang / bag chags tsam 'jog phyin yig nabru gcig mu chad pa'i tshul du/ rang lo rde bzhi'i sa zla'i tshesakhri/ 'go btsoyis/ bdun cu'i pho mjug zla dgu bar rmajug grub 5sabadag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba nadi'i mthu lamu/ rgyul ba'i bstan padin po tshe dan zhing rgyasal yun ring du gnasapa dang / de 'dzin pa'i sgyesachen darma pa rnayis kyi sku tshe zhabasapad brtan cing thugasabazhed mutha' dag lhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyun 'gro ba'i skyabs smon rnan/ par dag pa rde gnang rgyu gusapa tshen posazhu zhu lags/smus pa/ gang dag sesmras can ma zhusa'akhon ba'i yitha' lamu bsgroyi phyin semasabaskyed de/ gang du skyesakyang gzhin 5na

706 ༄7//〈bka' 'gyur 〉klog skabs dran gsor bris deb/bsgrub la mi brtson skabasani yod min 5/ gang gi rdon du lusasrog longs sbyod 'thangs pa med 5na nab sbyin pas/gang nas dpyad skyong rtsod sped shākya thub pa'i dbang bor gus phyag 3tshal/ gang der bzhugasakung bla na yo yichimu pa'i/gangasacan 'gro ba'i bla yi tsong kha ba/ gang la gang 'tshamu de yi den ston 5'i/ gangasacan bzhad pa'i rdo rje nirma byon 'dud/ sngonanas byang chub dam ba rmachog brnyeyotung / sngon pyon bshemu gnyen dmu pa'i tshulabazung nasu/ sngon bsagamu mas kyis 'thangasapa'i skyesabo dang / sngon 'gro'i wamu ston yikhamu pa na gusaphyag 'tshal/ dran no dran no bla ma dran/ yobamumayi bsayi sgongs pamu bsgribs/ bamuyimu na bamuyiyon 'alhod pa skyemu/ skye zhing skye ban skardol banasnon/ spyir ni dkon mchog rnasmragasum mkhyen/ khyad 5ra kun mkhyen glayi mkhyen/ nang dgoyoyongasa'adzin dmu pa mukhyen/ bdag gi bamusga don 'grub 5na thog/ bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / bla mu'i thugayobazhed 'grub pa'i phyin/ bla na med 5'i dmu pa'i chos/ bla nasablar wang sgajalabar shog/ rgyal ba'i bka' ni 2gyun no cog/gsal dag rdzogs pa'i ngag 'don zhig/ mi nuyode lanongamu par 'tshal/ gang numu de ni 'don pan bya/zhes nab gnasasaphosarmo'i zla 11tshe51la/ skatsho kha ba'i ming tsarma yod 5 skayi bzang ba༈na 'dzin rgya rmatshosabrimu/
